use.flag: Switch to GKI kernel for ARCVM
Enable crosvm's virtio-gpu "cross-domain" context type for ARCVM.
Enable crosvm's virtio-gpu "cross-domain" context type for Borealis.
Enable the virtio video decoder. Enabled by default but disabled on betty which does not have hardware video decoder.
If the virtio video decoder is enabled, then use the VD host service instead of the default VDA host service. If the virtio video decoder is not enabled, then the flag has no effect.
Enable BigGL when libglvnd is available.
Enable crosvm's virtio-gpu "native context" context type.
